name: imcp
description: Expose iMCP tools through an authenticated bridge.
instructions: Publish or copy the contents of this plugin/imcp source subtree as the root of a dedicated plugin repository, then tell Stavrobot to install <plugin repo URL>. Configure bridge_token through Stavrobot web settings or a trusted host-side secret path; never paste it into agent chat. The token is used only for authentication and is never included in tool responses or errors.

bridge_url.description: HTTP URL of the host iMCP bridge.

bridge_token.description: Bearer token configured for the host iMCP bridge.
